name: Jardinópolis (São Paulo, Brazil)
description: Six horizontal stripes of green, yellow, dark blue, white, red and black, the colours of the flags of Brazil and São Paulo, with a grey map of São Paulo state in the canton and the municipal arms at the centre.
history: Jardinópolis is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 10 November 1983 (prescribed by Municipal Law No. 1,157 of 10 November 1983, modified by Law No. 1,723 of 22 September 1993, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: map of São Paulo state with a dot marking the town
municipal arms with a mural crown, a shield with a sword and a map of Brazil, between coffee branches
